description: Sign a person in when no API token is configured, the way this server allows. Over stdio (the server runs on the person's computer) method auto, the default, opens the person's browser at Thalovant's consent page and waits for it to come back to this server on 127.0.0.1 (PKCE, RFC 8252). Only a browser that shares this server's 127.0.0.1 can complete it, so a link or code sent to someone on another computer delivers nothing to the sender; a stdio server started over SSH without forwarding the port, or inside a container, does not share the person's, so use method device there. When this computer cannot show a browser (over SSH, in CI, or without a display) or the API does not offer browser sign-in yet, auto starts a device login instead (method device in the answer, with userCode and verificationUri to show). Over Streamable HTTP this server's 127.0.0.1 is not the person's, so auto and device start a device login exactly as thalovant_begin_device_login does, and method browser is refused. Show the person what the answer names, then call the poll tool its next field names with loginId. What a browser sign-in promises does not hold for a device login: whoever approves its code signs this server in as their account, so show the code only to the person signing in. The verifier, the state, the device code and the token stay on this server; once approved, control-plane tools for this principal use the token. A Home Assistant link signs in as its registered app: use thalovant_begin_device_login with clientId for it.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

deviceName.description: What the consent page and the dashboard's token list show for this computer (a device login's client name). Default `thalovant-mcp on <hostname>` over stdio; an empty string sends no name, so the hostname stays off the consent page.

method.description: auto (the default): the browser when this computer can show one and the API offers it, a device login otherwise. browser: the browser, or an error (never a device login); it completes only in a browser that shares this server's 127.0.0.1 (not over SSH without port forwarding, not inside a container), and it is refused over Streamable HTTP. device: a device login.

scopes.description: Scopes the token will carry. Omitted or empty asks for the API's default (hubs:read and clients:write for a browser sign-in). Any non-admin scope may be asked for; the API refuses admin or unknown ones when the person approves.

timeoutMs.description: How long the sign-in waits for the person, in milliseconds, on either transport. Past it the server stops polling for a device code even when the code itself lives longer at the API (expiresIn reports the shorter), so approving the code later signs nothing in here. Default each method's own: 300000 for the browser, 900000 for a device login.

name: thalovant_begin_browser_login
title: Begin Browser Sign-In
